tasks.title: Validate bounded source refresh input
outputs: URL validation, response limit, redirect, and failure behavior
acceptance: Unsupported schemes, credentials, redirects, non-2xx responses, and oversized bodies fail before snapshot persistence.
tasks.next_step: Implement bounded URL and response validation with injected fetch.

tasks.title: Persist authorized source refresh snapshots
outputs: Authorized refresh route with digest-backed snapshot and Chronicle change event
acceptance: A paired authorized refresh preserves prior snapshots, records the new digest/status, and invalidates examined/evaluated states without changing unrelated resource data.
tasks.next_step: Add refresh persistence after validation primitives pass.

tasks.title: Validate paired Relay workflow
outputs: Paired refresh success and recoverable failure evidence
acceptance: Paired HTTP refresh succeeds for the selected resource, failures are bounded and non-persistent, and existing pairing/scope behavior remains intact.
tasks.next_step: Run paired success and failure journeys after integration.

tasks.title: Prepare local Relay candidate
outputs: Review, release report, notes, recovery record, artifact, and compatibility record
acceptance: Local v1.3.0 candidate passes the release gate, has a reproducible checksum, preserves v1.2.4 rollback, and remains unpublished without new authorization.
tasks.next_step: Prepare local artifact and closeout after Relay checks pass.
